seed: Objects of type `block` under action ACTION3 with touching neighbours [arm] show mixed outcomes: x x22, no_change x10, tags x1. Find the condition in the before state that decides the outcome. Start from this kind of condition: the exact click position relative to the object, when the action is a click. Verify it against every transition before you keep it.

synth.notes:
Crane/skewer: A1/A2 move ring+beam y-/+6, carrying blocks on beam and pushing anything hit; out-of-bounds cancels.
A4/A3 beam w+/-6 (1..43); hooked tip block (x==tip-4) drags all blocks on beam; else extend pushes swept blocks.
Hypothesis answer: block A3 outcome = whether a hooked block exists and the dragged chain would overlap the ring (blocked -> beam slides alone, no_change).
Tags: hooked next block alone on beam -> collected, rightmost todo -> next; collected off beam reverts.
Unconfirmed: exact bounds (block y>=2, x+4<=56, ring y in [0,58]); blocked hooked extend assumed to slide.
